later changes override conflicting earlier preferences. Safety reframes disclosed
in the current brief are legitimate, but unrelated lost constraints are not.

word counts come from code. Scores must reflect the text, not a target average.

preserve. Empty fixes is allowed when no useful repair is needed. Provide exactly
one arousal estimate per paragraph (1=still, 3=active but gentle, 5=intense). These
are subjective editorial annotations, not sleep or developmental measurements.
